title: Showcase: a model of your own, with the loop guard
description: The agent works with a model on your own server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM or another OpenAI-compatible one) and reaches nothing else; the start sets its sampling and a strict loop guard, and the agent shows both: what it can reach, a small task, and the guard's note when it repeats itself; a report says what it saw.

de.title: Schaufenster: ein eigenes Modell, mit Schleifenschutz
de.description: Der Agent arbeitet mit einem Modell auf Ihrem eigenen Server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM oder ein anderer OpenAI-kompatibler) und erreicht sonst nichts; der Start setzt die Sampling-Parameter und einen strengen Schleifenschutz, und der Agent zeigt beides: was er erreicht, eine kleine Aufgabe und den Hinweis des Schutzes, wenn er sich wiederholt; ein Bericht sagt, was er gesehen hat.

llm.label: LLM server (sandbox-ai llm list), NAME or NAME:MODEL
llm.hint: sandbox-ai llm add ollama --kind ollama --url http://127.0.0.1:11434 --model MODEL

temperature.label: Temperature of the model for this start (0 to 2)
temperature.hint: 0.6 to 0.7 for most coding models; 0 is greedy and prone to loops

prompt: You run on a model of the user's own server, and nothing else is reachable. Show what that means and write a short report to /work/llm-report.md: (1) what you are: the model you were given, if you can tell; (2) what you can reach: curl -sS -m 10 https://api.anthropic.com/ and https://example.com/ - both refused (quote the refusals); (3) a small task: /work/fizzbuzz.py with a function fizzbuzz(n) and a test /work/test_fizzbuzz.py (unittest), run it and quote the result; (4) the loop guard: run exactly the same command, cat /work/fizzbuzz.py, three times in a row and look at each result for a note of sandbox-ai's loop guard (it begins with [sandbox-ai loop guard]); quote it and stop repeating as soon as it appears; (5) the sampling this start set (temperature {temperature}, max_tokens 8192), as far as you can tell. Change nothing else.
notes: Register the server once: sandbox-ai llm add NAME --kind ollama|lmstudio|llamacpp|vllm|openai-compatible --url URL --model MODEL (--anthropic for a gateway with the Anthropic Messages API, which Claude Code needs); sandbox-ai llm check NAME --agent AGENT asks the server whether it has the API that agent needs, sandbox-ai llm params lists the parameters each kind takes.
On this host's loopback (http://127.0.0.1:PORT) only with Podman: sandbox-ai opens that one port for the sandbox. In your LAN or tailnet: a private address, or https.

--llm-param sets this start's sampling over the server's and the agent's own values (temperature, max_tokens) and the loop guard: on, a note in the tool result after the same tool call with the same result twice (warn=2), tool use paused for that answer after four (block=4). The connection proxy applies them to this server's requests only; each note of the guard names itself as the loop guard's.
The agent reaches nothing but the server (--no-provider-defaults): no cloud provider, its login is not copied in; the server's key stays with the connection proxy.
